summary: Ship Copperplate CC Bold with the client fonts
author: pm
body:
User, 2026-11-25: 'Add Copperplate CC Bold along side the ttf fonts shipped'. Added staged/client/fonts/copperplate_cc_bold.otf (byte-identical to CopperplateCC-Bold.otf from the Cowboy Collective zip on fontsquirrel.com) and copperplate-cc-OFL-1.1.txt (the copyright line and source, then the OFL text from the zip). The font declares no Reserved Font Name. It is an OTF with CFF outlines: the panel kit's font check (panel_kit.cpp:579, as of 2026-11-25) accepts only .ttf names, so using it from the kit needs that check widened. FreeType reads OTF.

**Done when:** both files are committed in staged/client/fonts.

**Closed, 2026-11-25:** committed in 9d8f15b1; the font file is byte-identical to the download (checked with cmp).
